title: Azure Storage Table (mscs:storage:table / mscs:vm:metrics) events
description: Field schema for the Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services Azure Table Storage input, covering the generic table-entity sourcetype and its VM Metrics (WAD) variant.

tableEntityEvent.title: Azure Storage Table -- storage:table
tableEntityEvent.description: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services Azure Table Storage event, sourcetype mscs:storage:table. Any user-defined columns present in the table schema appear as top-level fields with their native types (string integer boolean datetime binary guid etc.)

PartitionKey.description: Partition key of the table entity (system property)

RowKey.description: Row key of the table entity (system property - unique within partition)

Timestamp.description: Last updated timestamp of the entity (system property)

odata.type.description: OData type annotation for the entity

odata.editLink.description: OData edit link for the entity

TableName.description: Name of the Azure Table being queried (add-on metadata)

vmMetricsTableEvent.title: Azure Storage Table -- vm:metrics
vmMetricsTableEvent.description: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services Azure Table Storage event, sourcetype mscs:vm:metrics.

Average.description: Average value of the counter in the sample interval

Minimum.description: Minimum value of the counter in the sample interval

Maximum.description: Maximum value of the counter in the sample interval

Total.description: Total/sum value of the counter in the sample interval

Count.description: Number of samples collected in the interval

TIMESTAMP.description: Sample timestamp from WAD metrics table

PartitionKey.description: Partition key (often encodes date/time or deployment)

RowKey.description: Row key (often encodes counter and instance)
